method: Real data only. One directed Dijkstra (modeled walking time, x -> habitat) on the full native HiRISE DTM window, same rules as the routes (per-pixel Horn slope <= 15°, endpoint grade <= 15°, diagonal corner rule, Pandolf x kappa, standing-load downhill floor, constants.json). Return keys sit every ~KEY_SPACING_M along the route; from route point i the way home is: walk this route back to the key at or before i, then the fastest pixel path home.
